title: Create Elements UI Bundle and Migrate Sketchpad Elements
description: Create a new elements technology with a ui bundle that owns the shared UI elements now living in compose/js/sketchpad. Migrate element exports and imports from sketchpad into compose js, and move the Storybook to the new ui bundle so compose/js consumes the bundle instead of hosting the element source and stories.
summary: Removed the remaining compatibility layer from the elements migration. compose/js no longer hosts or wraps Storybook, no longer re-exports shared element primitives, and no longer ships the old sketchpad elements shim. Shared UI consumers now import directly from @elements/ui, and the moved Storybook remains the only host for those elements. Verified compose/js tests pass and elements/ui Storybook builds successfully.
